the energy-dependence and the structure of the mass-operator in the nuclear shell model.
the energy dependence of the mass-operator M(ε) and the effective interaction Veff(ε).

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy-dependence is not a property of the mass-operator, but of the T-matrix and that the energy-dependences of the mass-operator are not a property of a T-matrix.
the energy-dependence and the energy-averaging of the mass-operator is a nontrivial problem and that a “correct” definition of the energy-averaged effective-interaction is still lacking.
the energy dependence of the T-matrix is not a simple function of the energy dependence of either the mass-operator or the “effective-interaction”.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy-dependence is a result of the energy-dependence in the mass-operator and in the effective interaction.
the energy dependence of theT-matrix and the mass-operator is determined by the energy dependence of a p-p and p-h collective motion.
the energy-dependence is not due to the effective-interaction, but to the mass-operator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
this effective interaction is energydependent, and that the energy-dependence is due to the energy-dependence (and energy-variation) of the p-p and p-h collective modes.
